Title: Public Preview – Azure Portal experience for Azure Database Migration Service

Body.Content:
Now, you can use DMS to perform migrations either from the Azure Portal, or ADS extension (Azure SQL Migration), or Azure PowerShell/CLI. 

The Azure Portal experience will allow you to perform the following tasks: 

  • Like DMS (classic), you can now create a new Database Migration Service from Azure Portal. 

  • Start migration from SQL Server on-premises to the following Azure targets: 

- Azure SQL Managed Instance (Offline / Online) 

- Azure SQL Virtual Machine (Offline / Online) 

- Azure SQL Database (Offline) 

  • Access an integration runtime configuration page to download self-hosted integration runtime and copy registration keys to configure an integration runtime.  

The Azure Portal experience also provides a target-based customized list of prerequisites, documentation, and tutorial links. 

Learn More: 

DMS Azure Portal : https://aka.ms/dmsazureportal 

DMS overview: https://aka.ms/dms-overview
